nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address of the contract owner, set to the deployer in the constructor.
Ownable.dev: hardcoded payable developer address receiving 20% of the contract balance in _withdrawAll.
DwarfsChilds._baseTokenURI: base URI prefix used by _baseURI().
DwarfsChilds.sexEnable: public flag gating the sex() minting function.
DwarfsChilds.baseSexPrice: minimum ETH required to call sex().
DwarfsChilds.MaxBoySexPrice: upper bound price parameter (1 ETH).
DwarfsChilds.MinBoySexPrice: lower bound price parameter.
DwarfsChilds.marketFee: market fee percentage variable (unused in logic).
DwarfsChilds.BabyBurthPercent: threshold (0-10000) compared against random output to decide child gender.
DwarfsChilds._mothers: mapping tokenId => mother token id.
DwarfsChilds._fathers: mapping tokenId => father token id.
DwarfsChilds._boySexPrice: internal mapping of per-token boy sex price (unused).
DwarfsChilds._sex: mapping tokenId => gender boolean.
DwarfsChilds.DAW: external DwarfsChilds contract reference (fathers) at 0x3923...cA451.
DwarfsChilds.DWG: external DwarfsChilds contract reference (mothers) at 0x2BB3...82b59.
sex(address,uint,uint) payable: mints a child token after checking payment, ownership of mother/father tokens, and pseudo-random gender.
random(uint) public view: returns a pseudo-random number derived from block.difficulty and block.timestamp.
Ownable._withdrawAll(): splits contract balance 20/80 and transfers to dev and _msgSender().
withdrawAll() payable onlyOwner: owner-triggered wrapper around _withdrawAll().
setBaseURI(string) onlyOwner: updates _baseTokenURI.
setBaseSexPrice(uint,uint,uint) onlyOwner: updates sex price configuration.
setSexEnable(bool) onlyOwner: toggles the sex minting gate.
setBabyBurthPercent(uint) onlyOwner: updates the gender probability threshold.
transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner: transfers _owner to a new address.
owner() public view: returns _owner.
renounceOwnership() internal onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0).
_baseURI() internal view override: returns _baseTokenURI.
tokensOfOwner(address) external view: enumerates all token ids owned by an address.
DAWview(address) external view: forwards tokensOfOwner to the DAW contract.
DWGview(address) external view: forwards tokensOfOwner to the DWG contract.
showGenderParents(uint) public view: returns gender, mother and father of a child token.
ERC721._safeMint(address,uint): mints a token then performs the receiver callback check.
ERC721._checkOnERC721Received: performs an external onERC721Received callback on contract recipients.
DwarfsChilds constructor(string): initializes ERC721 metadata and base URI.
ERC721._transfer: updates _balances and _owners when a token moves.
ERC721._mint: increments _balances[to] and records the owner of a token id.
ERC721._burn: decrements _balances[owner] and deletes _owners[tokenId].
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: requires owner() == _msgSender().
ERC721.safeTransferFrom: approved-transfer entry point calling _safeMint style receiver checks.
ERC721.transferFrom: approved-transfer entry point calling _transfer.
ERC721Enumerable._beforeTokenTransfer: maintains enumeration arrays on mint/transfer/burn.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): externally controlled caller address.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time value used as randomness entropy.
payable(dev).transfer(balanceDev): external ETH transfer to the developer address.
payable(_msgSender()).transfer(balanceNftgangs): external ETH transfer to the caller.
DWG.ownerOf(_mo): external call to an untrusted contract during sex().
DAW.ownerOf(_pa): external call to an untrusted contract during sex().
IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(...): external callback executed during _safeMint before state settlement.
uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.difficulty, block.timestamp))): timestamp-dependent pseudo-randomness.
_balances[to] += 1 balance increment in _mint.
_balances[from] -= 1 balance decrement in _transfer.
sex(address _to): recipient of the newly minted child token.
sex(uint _mo): mother token id whose ownership is verified against the caller.
sex(uint _pa): father token id whose ownership is verified against the caller.
random(uint _COUNTER): multiplier applied to the entropy value.
setBaseURI(string baseURI): new base URI value.
setBaseSexPrice(uint _baseSexPrice): new base price.
setBaseSexPrice(uint _MaxBoySexPrice): new maximum price.
setBaseSexPrice(uint _MinBoySexPrice): new minimum price.
setSexEnable(bool _sexEnable): new enable flag.
setBabyBurthPercent(uint _BabyBurthPercent): new gender threshold.
tokensOfOwner(address _owner): address whose tokens are enumerated.
DAWview(address _owner_): address forwarded to the DAW contract.
DWGview(address _owner_): address forwarded to the DWG contract.
showGenderParents(uint _childid): child token id to inspect.
transferOwnership(address newOwner): new owner address.
_withdrawAll local balanceDev = address(this).balance*20/100 (developer share).
_withdrawAll local balanceNftgangs = remaining balance transferred to _msgSender().
random() local gender: derived pseudo-random value modulo 10000.
tokensOfOwner local tokenCount = balanceOf(_owner).

edges.reason: sex() requires msg.sender to be the owner of the mother and father tokens and to be the contract owner or sexEnable.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender().
_withdrawAll sends ETH to _msgSender(), i.e. the caller controlled address.
random() uses block.timestamp as entropy, making the outcome miner-influenceable.
The keccak256(block.difficulty, block.timestamp) expression is the timestamp-dependent randomness source.
sex() consumes random(totalSupply()) to decide whether the child is male or female.
balanceDev is forwarded to the developer via an external transfer.
balanceNftgangs is forwarded to the caller via an external transfer.
The hardcoded dev address is the recipient of the external transfer.
withdrawAll() invokes _withdrawAll(), which performs external ETH transfers.
onlyOwner guards withdrawAll from unauthorized callers.
onlyOwner guards setBaseURI.
onlyOwner guards setBaseSexPrice.
onlyOwner guards setSexEnable.
onlyOwner guards setBabyBurthPercent.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner reads owner() to derive the authorized address.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
sex() calls DWG.ownerOf(_mo) on an external contract.
sex() calls DAW.ownerOf(_pa) on an external contract.
sex() mints via _safeMint, triggering the onERC721Received callback on contract recipients.
sex() writes the mother id into _mothers.
sex() writes the father id into _fathers.
sex() writes the child gender into _sex.
sex() reads baseSexPrice to validate msg.value.
sex() reads sexEnable as a gating condition.
sex() queries the DWG contract reference.
sex() queries the DAW contract reference.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received callback.
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() as the operator argument to the callback.
_mint increments _balances[to] by one.
_transfer decrements _balances[from] by one.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer after approval checks.
safeTransferFrom path leads to the safe mint/transfer receiver validation.
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable.
setBaseURI writes _baseTokenURI.
_baseURI reads _baseTokenURI.
setBaseSexPrice writes baseSexPrice.
setBaseSexPrice writes MaxBoySexPrice.
setBaseSexPrice writes MinBoySexPrice.
setSexEnable writes sexEnable.
setBabyBurthPercent writes BabyBurthPercent.
showGenderParents reads _sex.
showGenderParents reads _mothers.
showGenderParents reads _fathers.
DAWview forwards the token enumeration call to the DAW contract.
DWGview forwards the token enumeration call to the DWG contract.
The constructor calls the onlyOwner-guarded setBaseURI during deployment.
_to is passed as the mint recipient in sex().
_mo is the mother token id used in sex().
_pa is the father token id used in sex().
_COUNTER multiplies the entropy value in random().
baseURI is assigned to _baseTokenURI in setBaseURI.
_baseSexPrice is written to baseSexPrice.
_MaxBoySexPrice is written to MaxBoySexPrice.
_MinBoySexPrice is written to MinBoySexPrice.
_sexEnable is written to sexEnable.
_BabyBurthPercent is written to BabyBurthPercent.
_owner is enumerated in tokensOfOwner.
_owner_ is forwarded to DAW.tokensOfOwner.
_owner_ is forwarded to DWG.tokensOfOwner.
_childid indexes the gender/parent lookups in showGenderParents.
newOwner is assigned to _owner in transferOwnership.
balanceDev is the amount sent to dev via external transfer.
balanceNftgangs is the amount sent to _msgSender() via external transfer.
balanceDev is computed inside _withdrawAll.
balanceNftgangs is computed inside _withdrawAll.
gender is the timestamp-derived random value returned by random().
tokenCount drives the enumeration loop in tokensOfOwner.
